caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate horn lying on its side atop a dark, shadowed surface. The horn is made of clear material resembling glass or crystal, intricately patterned with geometric shapes and star-like designs, and displays a range of light blue and pale gray highlights where the facets catch the light. The mouth of the horn is broad with a jagged, multi-angled edge, while the body of the horn narrows and curves, ending in a smooth, pointed tip. The finer end of the horn appears silvery or metallic. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset depicting a simple line sketch of the horn in profile, annotated with a different scale. The main drawing and the inset both have labeled scales, with “SCALE 8 1/2 = 1” below the main image and “SCALE 5 1/2 = 1” below the insert. Everything is drawn on a cream or off-white paper background, with a faint boundary marking the frame of the composition.
title: Glass Flower Holder
